name: @portfolio/root
description: Portfolio multi-niche de Pablo Contreras (bypabloc) - Astro 6 monorepo
author: Pablo Contreras <pacg1991@gmail.com>

scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .astro node_modules/.vite coverage
scripts.docker:up: docker compose --project-name portfolio -f docker/docker-compose/local.yml --env-file docker/env/.local up -d --build
scripts.docker:test:up: docker compose --project-name portfolio -f docker/docker-compose/test.yml --env-file docker/env/.test up -d --build
scripts.docker:stage:up: docker compose --project-name portfolio -f docker/docker-compose/stage.yml --env-file docker/env/.stage up -d --build
scripts.feature:up: docker compose --project-name portfolio -f docker/docker-compose/local.yml --env-file docker/env/.local --profile feature up -d feature
scripts.feature:report: docker exec portfolio-feature-local pnpm exec playwright show-report --host 0.0.0.0
